label: Resume dispatch or enforce deadline
retries: Check active calls every 15 seconds. Defer background recovery while active; otherwise one due task per alarm.

retries: Never retry call initiation; ambiguous dispatch remains unresolved.

impact: Owner confirmation established receipt for the first voicemail. Future calls still require their own receipt evidence.

name: Non-Twilio quote expires
impact: New calls block until the operator refreshes non-Twilio and fixed cost allowances.

name: How one authorized call reaches an outcome
description: The client first awaits provider checks of configuration, routing, credits, rates and funding. The coordinator then persists a pending call and alarm and returns an ID. A later alarm dials once. The three primary clients have authenticated. Additional Claude profiles need separate sign-in.

name: How calls survive disconnects
focus: How are redials, overruns and retained private content prevented?
description: Saved dispatch state prevents redial. Active-call checks take priority over old analysis or billing work; termination requests can repeat until confirmed. Ordered provider observations cannot regress final results. At 30 days content expires and unresolved calls leave a content-free block.

name: What one telephone conversation can know and do
focus: What can the voice agent do?
description: A fresh brief supplies facts and authority. The configured model can wait, select menu digits, handle voicemail and hang up. Corrected text examples and one real voicemail were accepted; physical keypad delivery and acoustic hold timing remain unverified.
